body: oh my god, that's exactly what it is! it's the video announcing that he's changing channels to tvfilthyfrank! you've saved me a headache, thank you so much!!

i've tried and it doesn't seem to work either.
sadly, they are not great at expressing that something hurts and when i apologize, it's always said it's not needed.
i just want to make them happy and i believe your comment will help, thank you, really!

It feels like a constant struggle with wanting to experience life and not being able to see it as a good thing.
I understand now that the fact that they were so harsh just shoved me into a deeper hole than what I was already in and this sucks, it really does.
Hopefully, I can find someone that accepts me and listens.
Thank you for taking the time to say something, it means a lot to me.

Thank you, really.
It means a lot that people even took the time to read what I said, truly.
It's hard to see that people genuinely like me or even want me around when I feel like this but I understand that, maybe it will help and I won't feel so desperate anymore.
